actions.Equip: allowlisted weapon string or {weapon:string}; empty string unequips
actions.Dash: optional direction Vector3; server validates and determines distance
actions.Gender: one of the original Male/Female/Fembxy strings; session preference for requester only
actions.Admin: {command:Kick|Kill|NoRespawn,target:username}; server checks original allowlist and rejects empty/ambiguous prefixes

authority: Server decodes opaque action IDs, validates requester/state/distance/cooldowns/targets, owns results, and broadcasts opaque presentation IDs to all connected Roblox clients. External clients decode presentation locally. Snapshot restores authoritative current state for late joiners.
ordering: State.revision and animationRevision reject stale snapshots and animation messages.
snapshot: {version,serverTime,states,voting,weather,admin}; states include gender, ownerTag and current animation; admin.allowed is private to the requester. No client credentials are gameplay authorization.
chatEmotes: Emote accepts wave/point/dance/dance1/dance2/dance3/laugh/cheer; the server selects an original variant and publishes chat/name/index.
